2.15.10
Subreport.Left
The Subreport.Left element specifies the distance of the subreport from the left of the subreport’s
container, such as a Rectangle or Body. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value
MUST be an RdlSize.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Left element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Left element.
 <xsd:element name="Left" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
